purpose: Measure whether the current complete native function can fit one fixed small TRAIN cohort; not intrinsic feature value, generalization or trading evidence.
reason: Current five-minute fullTRAIN results are weak; reviewed private qualifications prove two-step mechanics, and no equivalent repeated-small-cohort native fit control was found in the scoped evidence.

cohort.selection: Exactly the existing prefix._fixed_order(..., seed=20260911)[:256] diagnostic cohort; selected without labels. Same fixed order on every traversal.
cohort.normalization: Reuse current full-prefix frozen normalization; no refit.
cohort.shared_preparation_scope: Existing prefix._prepare may read the bound shared development target/axis backing before selecting TRAIN parents. No later-parent model forward, training, normalization fit or scoring. This is not a TRAIN-only file-read claim.

proposed_budget.origins: B16 and fixed256 cohort from current native runner. Update ceiling256 borrows one existing checkpoint interval as a proposed compute bound, not an existing training authorization or optimal learning budget.1200s is existing private diagnostic worker ceiling; actual runtime unknown.
proposed_budget.forward_budget_origin: Existing initial _evaluate(parity=True) uses17forwards;256trainingupdates+16finalevaluationforwards gives289. Retain canonical grad/no-grad parity guard.

numerics: Retain current 60-sign BCE objective, all active families/MTF, full model parameter partition, seed, deterministicFP32, AdamW LR/decay/betas/epsilon, clipping and batch16; change only declared subset repetition and update ceiling.

measurements.initial: Fresh full function, canonical grad/no-grad parity and saved initial256 parity before updates; all60 prediction panels on the same cohort.
measurements.final: Same256 cohort after bounded updates; all60 saved prediction panels, exact masks/axes, loss and actualupdate counters.
measurements.primary_fit_indicator: At5min report strict correct-sign count divided by eligible count; exact zero sign errors and no ties is a descriptive full-fit criterion. Initial/final logloss,Brier,AUC and all60 panels reported regardless of criterion.
measurements.intermediate: Reuse actual per-update loss/counters; no extra evaluation sweep or checkpoint selection.
measurements.weights: Diagnostic weights never reused by family fits; fixed terminal state only, no model selection.

interpretation.criterion_reached: Can fit these five-minute labels under these conditions; no assertion of generalization or useful market information.
interpretation.criterion_not_reached: Criterion not reached within declared budget. Does not isolate optimization, architecture, regularization, insufficient budget or conflicting labels at identical consumed inputs.
interpretation.incomplete: Deadline or technical stop is incomplete execution, not evidence of incapacity.

source_gap: Current full-fit contracts require47602rows/onepass/2976updates; private contracts requiretwo logicalsteps. Minimal explicitly bound diagnostic loop and native admission must be implemented/qualified after the scope decision; no existing consumed plan may be relabeled.
authority_boundary: Original family protocol fixes ten one-pass fits and no_extra_passes. This proposal is a separate repeated-subset training design and has no execution authority.
